long.title: How to Cook Perfect Rice on the Stove Every Time (Fluffy, Never Mushy)
long.description:
Tired of mushy, sticky or burnt rice? In this step-by-step video you'll learn how to cook rice perfectly on the stove, with fluffy separate grains every time. We cover measuring and rinsing the rice, the right water-to-rice ratio, boiling and simmering, why you shouldn't lift the lid, resting, fluffing, and how to store leftover rice safely. Works for long-grain, basmati and jasmine rice, and we explain brown rice too.

You'll need: long-grain white rice, a pot with a tight lid, a measuring cup, a fine mesh strainer, a fork.
